title: Cannellini Bean Mash
description: Cannellini beans simmered with garlic and stock then mashed until smooth, a quick low-calorie alternative to mashed potato.
ingredients: 2 × 400g cans cannellini beans, drained and rinsed
steps: Spray a small saucepan; add garlic; sizzle 30 seconds.
Add cannellini beans and stock; simmer 5 minutes.
Remove from heat; mash with a potato masher until smooth.
Season with salt and pepper and serve.
notes: Add herbs (rosemary, thyme) or finely grated lemon zest. Can replace cannellini beans with butter beans.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
